name: Lanes score
summary: A live bowling scoresheet drawn the classic way, frames and little boxes: each bowler taps the pins they knocked down on their own pin deck and rolls, strikes send a ball rolling across their row, totals and standings update for everyone, and last place after the tenth pays for shoes.
useWhen: bowling at midtown lanes tonight, keep score
scoresheet for thursday bowling, loser pays shoes
track our bowling game in the chat
who's winning at the lanes rn
bowling night score keeper for 6 people
dontUseWhen: a game played inside the chat itself (use tray-stack)
a bracket across several games (use group-tourney)

title.description: Card title, usually the alley, e.g. 'Midtown Lanes'

sub.description: Line under the title, e.g. 'lane 7 · Thursday'

stakes.description: What last place pays for, e.g. 'shoes'

players.description: Up to 8 bowlers in lane order, with pins knocked per roll so far (10 on a first ball is a strike) and an optional line
